description: Na₂Li₂Al₃Si₃O₁₂Cl crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅4 space group. Na is bonded to three O and one Cl atom to form distorted NaClO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.36 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.73 Å. Li is bonded to three O and one Cl atom to form LiClO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.08 Å. The Li-Cl bond length is 2.64 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiClO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.78 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiClO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiClO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiClO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.65 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.65 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Al, and one Si atom. Cl is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Li atoms.
